title: Genomic and transcriptomic data production for helminths
protocol: Shear DNA into 3kb fragments.
Blunt end the sheared DNA.
Ligate DNA to SOLiD Mate-Pair Cap Adapter.
Size fractionate ligated DNA to 2-4 kb fractions.
Purify size-fractionated DNA.
Set up circularization reactions using extracted fraction and Internal SoliD Mate Pair adaptor.
Remove linear or non-circularized fragments.
Nick-translate extended library using DNA polymerase I.
Treat nick-translation products with S1 nuclease for 15 minutes.
Blunt end resulting products.
Immobilize blunt-ended products using Dynal M270 Streptavidin beads.
Ligate FLX Titanium paired-end library adaptors onto immobilized DNA fragments for 454 sequencing as recommended by Roche 454.
For Illumina sequencing, perform an adenylation reaction on blunt-ended fragments.
Ligate Illumina’s Truseq adapters to the processed fragments.
Enrich the library with KAPA HiFi polymerase from KAPA Biosystems.
Perform a final dual SPRI size selection to isolate 300-500 bp library fragments.
Construct 8 kb span paired-end libraries for 454 sequencing according to Roche 454 recommendations, extracting the 6.5-9 kb fraction and purifying it using a Qiagen Gel Extraction Kit.
For Illumina sequencing of mate pair libraries, shear 15 μg high molecular weight DNA to an average fragment size of 8 kb with a Hydroshear.
Blunt end repair sheared fragments using DNA Terminator End Repair Kit from Lucigen.
Ligate Circularization Adapters at 20 µM concentration to the repaired fragments for Illumina sequencing.
Size-fractionate the ligated DNA and purify the 6.5-10 kb fraction using a Qiagen Gel Extraction Kit.
Circularize 300 ng of size-selected DNA with 10U Cre Recombinase.
Remove linear or non-circularized and nicked library fragments.
Fragment circularized library fragments targeting a mean insert size of 300 bp.
Blunt end the fragmented DNA using the DNA Terminator End Repair Kit (Lucigen).
Process the blunt-ended DNA through an adenylylation reaction (NEB).
Ligate Illumina's TruSeq adaptors to the adenylated fragments.
Immobilize the adenylated fragments with Dynal M270 Streptavidin beads.
Amplify the immobilized fragments with KAPA HiFi Polymerase (KAPA Biosystems).
Select final 300-500 bp library fragments with a dual SPRI reaction.
Remove adapters from 3kb, 8kb, and fragment Illumina sequences.
Perform quality trimming on the cleaned Illumina sequences.
Filter sequences by length after quality trimming.
Screen for contamination in the filtered sequences.
Assemble cleaned reads using the AllPaths-LG assembler.
Improve assembly using Pygap tool.
Improve assembly using L_RNA_scaffolder tool.
Map 3kb paired-end Illumina sequence data against the reference assembly using bwa aligner with default parameters.
Run Samtools mpileup on the alignment.
Use vcfutils.pl varFilter to identify differences between new reads and the reference backbone.
Omit SNP loci where alternate allele frequency is 1 from mapped regions.
Construct a new consensus populated with alleles from new reads at each detected SNP locus using FastaAlternateReferenceMaker method of GATK.
Assemble unmapped reads using Velvet with a kmer size chosen by VelvetOptimizer.
Compare contigs created by Velvet to the reference using BLAT.
Add Velvet contigs greater than 500 bp that mapped less than 50% of their length and at >80% identity to an existing contig to the assembly.
Identify adaptor sequences and contaminants in contigs using Megablast against a database of vectors, bacterial, and host contaminants.
Pick high-scoring segment pairs with E-value <0.01 and length >100 bp.
Remove contigs if the identity is greater than 75% and coverage is greater than 40% of the contig, or if the contig is less than 2000 bp.
Manually review any contigs on the border of removal requirements that are longer in length as an extra measure against true genome contigs being removed.
Generate transcriptome (RNAseq) libraries with the Illumina TrueSeq stranded protocol.
Clean raw reads using an in-house tool that trims adaptor sequences and applies quality and length filters.
Mask low complexity sequence using the filter_by_complexity tool in seq_crumbs package.
Identify contaminating sequences using Bowtie2 and TopHat2, then remove them.
Assemble cleaned RNAseq reads de novo with Trinity.
Filter assembled transcripts for the longest representative open reading frame.
Merge transcripts using CD-HIT with 98% coverage and identity.
Assess assembled contigs by aligning back to reference assembly with TopHat2.
Align assembled contigs to establish the percentage of reference aligned to by the reads.
Determine the percentage of reads that aligned to the reference.
Calculate the Quality Index \(QI\) criteria as follows:
Determine the length of the 5' UTR.
Calculate the fraction of splice sites confirmed by an EST.
Determine the fraction of exons that overlapped an EST alignment.
Determine the fraction of exons that overlapped EST or protein alignments.
Screen genes for overlaps, allowing less than 10% overlap.
Keep genes if QI\[2] and QI\[3] are both greater than zero, or if QI\[4] is greater than zero.
Retain genes if they match Swissprot using BLAST with an E value less than \(1e-06\).
Retain genes if they match Pfam using RPSBLAST with an E value less than \(1e-03\).
Run RPSBLAST against CDD with an E value less than \(1e-03\) and coverage greater than 40%.
Keep genes that meet both RPSBLAST cut-offs.
Retain genes if they have ≥55% identity to the KEGG genes database and a bitscore of ≥35, in the absence of any hits.
